object_description: Autonomous square volume with a centralized service core
design_condition: The square volume fails to establish a fruitful dialogue with its context, while new planting, a greened street, and a large water body connect and define the surrounding open space.

positive.statement: The clear intention to connect the existing river greenery with the school greenery is appreciated.
The large body of water positively defines the new limit and benefits the environmental aspects.

negative.statement: The strong formal autonomy ultimately fails to enter into a fruitful dialogue with the context.
The organization of the square plan suffers from the centrally occupied core and hotel-like corridors.
The lack of greenery inside the citadel raises questions about use during the hottest periods.
The structure is elaborate and its changing walls, pillars, cantilevers, and tapering lack a clear relationship with the architectural concept.
The significant glazing on all orientations must be verified because it is critical to achieving the expected energy standard.
The proposed treatment of existing walls erases their tactile and visual qualities and uses a material considered too fragile for the intended use.
